parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more specific personalization (citing exact profile values like income, expenses, $1.8M goal, catch-up contribution math) and more concrete, executable actions with precise dollar amounts and tickers. System B contains a notable factual error (calculating retirement spending at $30-45k/year when the user explicitly stated $80-100k/yr need) and recommends a dividend ETF that increases equity exposure, somewhat conflicting with the de-risking thesis.
